title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap **More info** on an item on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone come down in **Poland**, which calls it a likely **intentional provocation** timed to European military drills
items.summary_md: One Kh-101 landed in the village of Nowy Lipowiec during Russia's strikes on Ukraine; no one was hurt.

items.headline_md: **Trump** says he's "not rushing" a decision on new **Iran** strikes and will look at it after the start of the year
items.summary_md: He faces pressure from Netanyahu for a bombing campaign, while the naval blockade and economic pressure play out.

items.headline_md: **Denmark** expels Russia's defense attaché and halts non-essential visas for Russians after arrests in an alleged plot to kill a Ukrainian rapper
items.summary_md: The attaché has seven days to leave.

items.headline_md: A Russian morning attack on **Kyiv** injures two men and damages homes in three districts
items.summary_md: Falling debris set a private home on fire in Podil; one of the injured was hospitalized.

items.headline_md: Update: Reuters reports the SEC's **Nvidia** probe is focused on **accounting**, and the shares fell about **13%** Friday
items.summary_md: The stock had been down more than 6% before the report; the SEC declined to comment.

items.headline_md: **PayPal** names Xero's **Claire Bramley** CFO, replacing Jamie Miller in a wider leadership overhaul
items.summary_md: She starts in February 2027.

items.headline_md: **ABB** weighs listing its robotics unit if it can't save the **$5.4B** sale to SoftBank that China blocked
items.summary_md: One option is carving out the Chinese business, about 30% of the unit, sources told Reuters.

items.headline_md: NRF expects **182.7 million** people to shop over Thanksgiving weekend, down from 186.9 million last year
items.summary_md: 60% of shoppers started by early November.

sections.title: Games & mobile
sections.body_md: No new hyper-casual or mobile game news in the last 24 hours.

items.headline_md: Update: Take-Two says **GTA VI** made **$3.79B** in day-one retail sales, a record for any entertainment launch
items.summary_md: It also sold 32.5M units before release and scored 99 on Metacritic.

items.headline_md: Update: **Ubisoft** first-half net bookings drop **16.5%** to €644.7M, and it launches **Motherbrain**, a generative-AI gameplay subsidiary
items.summary_md: Motherbrain will build NPCs with memory and AI game masters.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: it's already public as [CafeRecomp](https://github.com/hardkiller2565123123/CafeRecomp), with BOTW as its first game; still no tagged GitHub release. GTA VI: still no verified native-PC recomp or port. Xmarc says his PS5-to-PC build only reaches the menu, and the viral PC video is a hoax made from GTA V footage ([XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/that-viral-gta-6-pc-port-video-hoax-made-from-recycled-gta-5-footage/)).

items.headline_md: **Eglantine**, the open-source **Switch 2** emulator forked from Eden, Yuzu and Sudachi, ships its Nov 19 build
items.summary_md: It adds a task/mesh-shader fallback toggle, throttles ASTC texture transcodes and fixes Linux builds.

items.headline_md: **Pulse of Time** adds full **DualSense** haptics, adaptive triggers and lightbar to the Switch 2 **Ocarina of Time** remake running in Lichii
items.summary_md: It's free and GPL-3.0, and only reads memory, so it doesn't modify the game or the emulator.

items.headline_md: **Batocera 44** is out with updated emulator cores and a new bootloader-flash option
items.summary_md: It updates online from the System menu.

items.headline_md: **DreamCart 64**: a modder wires an N64 cartridge slot to a **Dreamcast** to play N64 carts
items.summary_md: A microcontroller copies the cart's bus protocol to read game data.

items.headline_md: N64 emulator **gopher64 1.2.2** fixes integer scaling, Android flicker and audio, and improves its netplay lobby
items.summary_md: HBMAME 0.289.6 also adds a batch of hacks and homebrew.

items.headline_md: Update: **Sunrise on the Reaping** makes **$51M** Friday (including $21M previews), tracking toward a **$110M+** opening
items.summary_md: That's the series' fourth-best start, and possibly third if it isn't front-loaded, at 4,108 theaters.

items.headline_md: Globally, **Sunrise** reaches about **$76M** by Friday and opens No. 1 in 66 of 67 markets
items.summary_md: Deadline says a global opening of around $200M wouldn't be shocking.

items.headline_md: A **Home Alone** sequel is in early development at Disney, with **Macaulay Culkin**, Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg on the script
items.summary_md: Plot and casting are under wraps; Disney declined to comment.

items.headline_md: **Sterling K. Brown** is in talks to star with **Nicolas Cage** in Paramount's new **Longlegs** movie
items.summary_md: Osgood Perkins returns to direct; it's due Jan. 14, 2028.

items.headline_md: Anthropic mathematician **Levent Alpöge** says he and **Claude** proved the **Riemann hypothesis**, with a Lean-coded proof
items.summary_md: Independent checkers say it's very likely correct, but the full verification isn't done yet.

items.headline_md: Internal chats show Meta staff warned that its **Muse** agent read encrypted messages they didn't expect and mixed up users' conversations
items.summary_md: Meta says the erratic outputs showing bank and bitcoin balances weren't real.

items.headline_md: Ads: **Microsoft** now shows ads next to **AI Overviews on Bing** in every market except China
items.summary_md: They run through existing campaigns, including Performance Max and AI Max, with no extra setup.

items.headline_md: **Google** adds a sidebar of AI searches to its homepage, and hotel bookings and Lens now lead into **AI Mode**
items.summary_md: Google's November core update was still rolling out on day ten.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: It's Saturday, so US markets are closed and index futures reopen Sunday evening. Figures below are Friday's close unless noted.

items.summary_md: The world stock index fell 8.1% on the week, its biggest drop since early 2020, and the VIX closed at its highest since April 2025.

items.headline_md: Movers Friday: **chip stocks (SOX) −10.7%** (−17.1% on the week) and **Anthropic −9.1%** to **$88.30**, near its $83 IPO price
items.summary_md: Nvidia fell about 13% (see B1).
Silver fell 4.22% to $40.95.

items.headline_md: Crypto at 5:08 AM CT Saturday: **Bitcoin $57,868**, **Ether $1,639**
items.summary_md: Coinbase spot prices.

sections.title: Weather
sections.body_md:
No ice storm or tornado threat for the St. Louis area in the next 7 days (NWS/SPC). No active NWS alerts at either point ([NWS alerts](https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=38.7875,-90.6299)). NWS St. Louis expects light rain (generally 0.25" or less) late tonight into Sunday as a cold front passes, with only a 10–15% thunder chance in far southeast Missouri; today's low-to-mid 70s are near records, then below-normal, dry weather, and "confidence is high" the area stays impact-free through Thanksgiving ([NWS St. Louis discussion](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=LSX&issuedby=LSX&product=AFD), 5:02 AM CT). SPC: today's severe risk is western Oklahoma into south-central Kansas ([Day 1](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day1otlk.html)); Sunday's isolated severe chance is in the middle and lower Mississippi Valley, centered on Arkansas, north Louisiana and western Mississippi ([Day 2](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day2otlk.html)); none Monday ([Day 3](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day3otlk.html)) or in the Day 4–8 period ([Day 4–8](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/exper/day4-8/)). The 7-day NWS forecasts for both cities mention no snow, sleet or freezing rain. I didn't check the WPC winter outlooks, and the NWS API had no LSX Hazardous Weather Outlook.
